purpose: Gate bulk ingestion on retrieval usefulness and bounded context.
rules: Do not enable bulk ingestion solely because pages were fetched successfully.
All benchmark queries must respect the configured character budget.
A failed gate requires retrieval/index changes or a documented benchmark revision; it must not be bypassed silently.
Benchmark results are derived artifacts and should not contain the full source corpus.
next_gate: Run after the bounded pilot corpus is populated locally.
